name: claude-code-setup-optimizer
description: Two Claude Code plugins by David García Gordo: working-methods (the /forge-run spine — align → draft + grill ×3 → spec → re-grill ×2 → plan → verify, with 2 batched owner checkpoints; /grill, /handoff) and automations (the optimize-my-setup skill, hooks, /release, permission templates). For the full suite (+ forge-methodology, design-review, token-economy, swarm) use the dedicated catalog davidgarciagordo/claude-plugins — working-methods needs it to resolve its dependencies.

plugins.name: working-methods
plugins.description: /forge-run — the Forge methodology with ENFORCEMENT: 12 phases whose order lives in code (forge.js), machine-checked gates, and a hook that blocks the PR until the run's artifacts exist. Plus /grill (adversarial ×3 on any artifact) and /handoff (session relay), both usable standalone.

plugins.name: automations
plugins.description: Tailors a repo's entire Claude Code config (.claude: CLAUDE.md, settings.json permissions/hooks/env, skills, agents, workflows, .mcp.json, output-styles) via a deterministic scanner plus a mandatory multi-check gate — nothing is written until the user ticks it. Ships a fail-closed guard-append-only hook, /release, and templates (hooks, domain reviewer agents generated per repo, permissions allowlist). Language-agnostic.
